definitions.explanation: Demanding strict adherence to rules or standards, often describing a person's character, upbringing, or a system of discipline. Implies severity and unwillingness to tolerate lapses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳格|げんかく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だった。
examples.english: My father was a strict person.

examples.japanese: {厳格|げんかく}な⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was raised with a strict upbringing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{校則|こうそく}→校則：16056_kousoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{厳格|げんかく}で、⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れ→乱れ：11413_midare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: This school has strict rules, and even sloppy dress is not tolerated.

notes:
{厳格|げんかく} is a na-adjective describing strict adherence to rules, discipline, or moral standards. It implies sternness and an unwillingness to tolerate lapses.

FORMS:
- {厳格|げんかく}な〜: modifier ({厳格|げんかく}な⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧)
- {厳格|げんかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: adverbially (strictly, rigorously)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厳格|げんかく}な⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧: strict father
- {厳格|げんかく}な⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: strict education/upbringing
- {厳格|げんかく}な⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: strict standards
- {厳格|げんかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}する→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧: to apply rigorously

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR 「{厳|げん}」 WORDS:
- ⟦{厳密|げんみつ}→厳密：11885_genmitsu⟧: precise, exact (focuses on accuracy, not discipline)
- ⟦{厳重|げんじゅう}→厳重：11887_genjuu⟧: tight, stringent (focuses on security/precaution)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧: strict, harsh (broader and more common in everyday speech)
